name: catalog-variant-simple
description: CATALOG-VARIANT: a quick-look swatch popover on the catalog card lets a shopper pick a colour/finish/variant BEFORE placing. Covers an injected multi-variant IKEA product's popover (swatches, pick, arm), then a real tintable builtin sofa end-to-end: open popover, pick a non-default swatch, place it, confirm the placed item renders in the chosen colour. Desktop + mobile, light + dark. The popover open + swatch-pick + armedVariantProps steps drive the REAL card DOM; the final commit uses the same `addItem` store action `usePlacementController`'s doCommit calls (carrying the armed variant patch) at one known-clear coordinate so the screenshot is deterministic — the canvas-click merge path itself is proven separately in `usePlacementController.test.tsx` against a real synthetic click.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: flag-on-in-simple
steps.failMessage: catalogVariantPick should be ON in Simple mode (simple tier)

steps.name: inject-ikea-multi-variant-fixture
steps.eval: window.__store.setState({ userFurniture: [{ id: 'test-catalog-variant-ikea', name: 'Test IKEA Wardrobe', category: 'storage', kind: 'gltf', source: 'ikea', groupKey: 'test-wardrobe', activeVariant: 'white', variants: [ { finish: 'white', label: 'White', articleNumber: '1', url: 'https://example.com', assetId: 'a1', swatchHex: '#f2f2f2', glbMaterials: [] }, { finish: 'black-brown', label: 'Black-brown', articleNumber: '2', url: 'https://example.com', assetId: 'a2', swatchHex: '#221c18', glbMaterials: [] } ], defaultFootprint: { w: 1, d: 0.6, h: 2 }, uploadedAt: '2026-07-03T00:00:00.000Z', license: 'IKEA', attribution: 'IKEA test fixture' }] })

steps.name: verify-ikea-variant-btn
steps.eval: (function(){ const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-card')].find(c => c.textContent.includes('Test IKEA Wardrobe')); if (!card) throw new Error('IKEA fixture card not found'); if (!card.querySelector('.variant-btn')) throw new Error('No .variant-btn on the multi-variant IKEA card'); })()

steps.name: verify-ikea-two-swatches
steps.eval: (function(){ const n = document.querySelectorAll('.variant-pop-list .swatch').length; if (n !== 2) throw new Error('Expected 2 IKEA finish swatches, got ' + n); })()

steps.name: pick-ikea-black-brown
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.variant-pop-list .swatch')].find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Place in Black-brown'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Black-brown swatch not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: verify-ikea-armed
steps.failMessage: Picking the IKEA swatch should arm placement with { variant: 'black-brown' }

steps.name: clear-search
steps.eval: (function(){ const el = document.querySelector("input[aria-label='Search the furniture catalog']"); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(el, ''); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); })()

steps.name: open-sofa-popover
steps.eval: (function(){ const card = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-card')].find(c => c.textContent.includes('3-seat sofa')); if (!card) throw new Error('sofa card not found'); card.querySelector('.variant-btn').click(); })()

steps.name: pick-navy
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.variant-pop-list .swatch')].find(b => b.getAttribute('aria-label') === 'Place in Navy'); if (!btn) throw new Error('Navy swatch not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: verify-sofa-armed
steps.failMessage: Picking the Navy swatch should arm placement with { color: '#4a5a78' }

steps.name: commit-navy-sofa
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const props = { ...(st.armedVariantProps || {}) }; st.setItems(st.items.filter(i => i.defId !== 'sofa-3seat')); st.addItem({ defId: 'sofa-3seat', position: [9.6, 2.55], rotation: 1.5708, props }); st.setActiveDefId(null); })()

steps.name: verify-placed-navy-sofa
steps.failMessage: Navy sofa was not placed with the chosen colour

steps.name: verify-no-mobile-overflow
steps.eval: (function(){ const panel = document.querySelector('.modal-overlay .panel'); if (!panel) throw new Error('mobile finish sheet panel not found'); const r = panel.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.right > window.innerWidth + 1) throw new Error('finish sheet overflows the 390px viewport: right=' + r.right); })()
